meta.title: Audio Volume Booster - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Boost or reduce audio volume. Adjust gain from 0% to 200%. Download as WAV.
mergeAtLeast: Add at least {count} files to merge
clippingWarning: Volume above 100% may cause clipping and distortion in the exported audio.
webmNote: WebM/Opus uses browser MediaRecorder — bitrate and sample rate are browser-controlled.
gateDesc: Silences signals below the threshold. Attack controls how quickly the gate opens; Release controls how quickly it closes.
rnnoiseDesc: Deep learning model trained on voice. Removes background noise while preserving speech clarity.
rnnoiseSrWarning: Your audio is {sr} kHz. RNNoise works best at 48 kHz — it will be automatically resampled.
rnnoiseFirstRun: First run downloads AI model (~100 KB)
steps_audio-volume_1Desc: Select an audio file to adjust. Supported formats: MP3, WAV, OGG, AAC, FLAC. The file stays on your device throughout the entire process.
steps_audio-volume_2Desc: Drag the volume slider to boost (above 100%) or reduce (below 100%) the loudness. Click Preview to hear a sample at the new level before processing.
steps_audio-volume_3Desc: Click Apply to generate the volume-adjusted file. Download the result — ideal for normalizing audio levels across tracks or fixing quiet recordings.
desc: Boost or reduce audio volume. Adjust gain from 0% to 200%. Download as WAV.
hint: Click or drag audio files here (MP3 / WAV / OGG / AAC / FLAC / M4A / WebM, ≤50MB)
